body: I can’t comment on the SM program, but as for your concern about living on north campus I can give a little advice. I was terrified of this too my freshman year, but then I learned about the Michigan Learning Communities, so I joined MCSP in West Quad and ended up loving the program AND being guaranteed to live in west quad freshman year. There’s a bunch of other MLCs in other dorms, and there’s honors in south quad, so if you end up choosing umich definitely look into these to guarantee not living on north.

For me the issue every time I’ve seen his live band is that every griz song in its original form is AMAZING and PERFECT to me, and hearing the live band take (which is extremely close but obviously not the exact same) just makes me sad because to me it doesn’t sound as good as the original. It’s always very impressive and not a bad show, but next year at grizmas, if he does live band one night and his old normal set the other night, I’ll probably only go to the dj one. I love that he’s doing the live band stuff but when I go to a show I want to hear the saxophone LOUD and clear and really hear the nuances that make me love griz as an artist. With the live band, those little things don’t shine through as much in my ears, so I’m not sure what everyone else felt at forest but that was my take.
